description: This file defines the NoSeekStream class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, which implements the StreamInterface to prevent seeking on a stream.

classes.name: NoSeekStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that disables seeking functionality.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent seeking on the stream.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns false indicating seeking is not supported.
